name: v2.0.1
body:

name: v2.0.0
body:
A lot of these features were held back for a while due to effort and testing, and because we wanted to have a better settings page before adding much more. A lot of internal changes were made too, so please report any issues, especially relating to playback.

VacuumTube now gets the latest YouTube UI (including video previews)
Overhauled settings menu with categories and About page (thanks to @jaxsnjohnson and @angelator312 in #222)
Added SponsorBlock bar highlights and configurable categories
Added **Block Continue Watching** setting
Added **Show Remaining Time** feature (thanks to @Rhodan81 in #254)
Added experimental **Ultrawide Support** feature (#139, #213, thanks to @Jepl4r and @davidc360)
Added **Automatic Updates** setting (#234)
Added playback speed control keybinds (A + D) (thanks to @Rhodan81 in #242)
Added `--width`/`--height` CLI flags
Added explicit `--deeplink` CLI flag
Improved controller support (now uses internal Leanback code instead of custom code)
Improved playback reliability (should be less likely to get bot check)
Improved cast reliability (now dynamically advertises DIAL on all available interfaces)
Changed cast label to read better
Fixed `Ctrl+Shift+C` keybind
Fixed `Shift+Enter` keybind (#262)
Fixed SponsorBlock sometimes skipping in random places (#184)
Fixed deeplinks not supporting share links
Fixed `--no-window-decorations` CLI flag
Massive internal improvements
Updated to Electron v44.5.1

name: v1.8.2
body:
Added option to let you hide specific guide tabs
Added music mode feature (thanks to @jaxsnjohnson in https://github.com/shy1132/VacuumTube/pull/211)
Added "Features" tab to settings (thanks to @jaxsnjohnson in https://github.com/shy1132/VacuumTube/pull/211)
Fixed video playback issues sometimes happening ("Something went wrong") (thanks to @p-marb in https://github.com/shy1132/VacuumTube/pull/220)
Removed settings keybind on controllers due to being too easy to accidentally press

name: v1.8.1
body:
Added "Unlock Resolution" setting
Fixed maximum video resolution rounding down instead of up
Made macOS packages smaller (thanks to @jaxsnjohnson in #202 and #204)
Now providing ZIP macOS package (thanks to @jaxsnjohnson in #203)
Now providing separate architecture macOS packages, instead of just universal (thanks to @jaxsnjohnson in #205)

name: v1.8.0
body:
Casting from phone to VacuumTube now works without a TV code ("Device Discoverability" setting)
Upgraded to Electron v42.5.0
Fixed some video playback issues, particularly on NVIDIA GPUs
Fixed settings being able to be opened in Kids mode
Fixed login screen jumping on launch
Fixed maximum video resolution being higher than screen size

name: v1.6.4
body:
Added true portable mode on all platforms, you can either use `--portable (optional path)` or create a `portable.txt` file next to the executable, which can contain a path. The default is a `data` directory next to the executable.

Updated grammar of some settings in English to be grammatically correct
